label: Dynamic mapping (Search)
type: a mapping mode indexing every field automatically, as against a static mapping which indexes only explicitly-added fields. A configuration choice shared across type/object/collection/XATTRs mappings.
evidence: (Optional) To only index the fields you add to the child mapping, select only index specified fields. Otherwise, your child mapping is a dynamic mapping.
(Optional) To switch from a dynamic type mapping to a static type mapping, select Only index specified fields.
relates_to_competency_question: Does a Search mapping have to explicitly list every field to index, or can it index a whole document/object automatically?
